rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a bodily injury or wound.

example.english: I still have some injury in my leg, so walking hurts.
example.traditional: 我隻腳仲有啲傷，行路會痛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 zung6 jau5 di1 soeng1 haang4 lou6 wui5 tung3

rows.note: Use this for harm or damage, especially psychological harm, rather than a bodily wound.

example.english: Talking like that can cause injury to people.
example.traditional: 你咁樣講，會對人造成傷害㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 wui5 deoi3 jan4 zou6 sing4 soeng1 hoi6 gaa3
